description: Agent Triage: submit the queue items with their ages and reviews: each item with its id, its state (open, waiting, in progress or closed), when it entered the queue and when it left, when it was re-reviewed while it waited, and its own review point, such as 2 days; and optionally the review point for any item that states none and the moment to read the queue at. The signed report gives every item with its age, its reviews, its review point, the current wait of an open item and its status as reviewed, reviewed_late, overdue, untouched, unwatched or unconfirmed, counts the items, the open items, the reviews and the items untouched, overdue and reviewed late, and states the review point and the moment read, and names aging ignored: waiting items that have sat untouched past their review point since entering the queue, and waiting items past their review point since their last review; then items that went past the point between reviews and were caught up later, with the fix for each. This reads a queue of items over time rather than the dates inside one document, which is wever_deadline-check: open invoices totaled by overdue bucket are wever_invoice-aging-brief, and open-commitment statuses gone stale on a ledger are wever_commitment-tracking-check. Verdict aging_ignored, aging_partial, aging_unwatched or aging_reviewed. POST /api/triage-aging-check. Reads only the recorded queue items and records in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write; no item is captured, ranked, routed, escalated or closed and no queue is changed. Agent Triage reads how an agent sorts incoming work, from the item captured at intake to the disposition it ends with: it is not multi-agent coordination (how a group of agents organizes shared work, with its own escalation path, the wever_coordination checks; triage escalation is a single queue item breaching its threshold and moving up a tier, with its context attached), not the promises an agent has made (promises and deadlines once they are made, the wever_commitment checks; triage decides handling order and routing before any promise exists), not delegation (handing work off with authority, the wever_delegation checks; triage assigns incoming items to queues and owners, a sorting decision rather than a delegation) and not the dates inside one document (wever_deadline-check; the triage checks read a queue of items over time). Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-triage-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-triage/.

items.description: Each queue item with its age and reviews.

id.description: The item id, such as q1.

review_every.description: Its own review point: how long it may wait between reviews, such as 2 days.

reviews.description: When it was re-reviewed while it waited, as dates and times.

state.description: Open, waiting, in progress or closed.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

read_at.description: The moment to read the queue at.

review_every.description: How long any item may wait between reviews, such as 3 days, when an item states none.

name: wever_triage-aging-check
title: Triage aging check
